ty-only law: time has no visible effect once P is accounted for. The rate rises steeply at low density, peaks near P≈4.4 at about 8.5, then declines slowly, and it appears to have a positive intercept near P=0 (about 2).

Best candidate so far:
dP/dt = 45.4·P/(25.2+P)·(1−P/8.29) + 1.17·ln(1+P/0.045)
